review.official:
Cliffheart is a
Rhodes Island
Operator
who was born in
Kjerag
. She is a specialist in rock and mountain climbing and is proficient with all kinds of climbing tools. Currently, she is undergoing treatment for
Oripathy
at Rhodes Island.

files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Fusion Rate] 7%
Due to puncturing by an Originium stone, Operator exhibits visible Originium crystals at the puncture site.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.28u/L
Course of infection is transitioning to the middle-term but has not yet had a significant impact upon the infected.

Cliffheart is a natural explorer and climber. Her reflexes and endurance far exceed what normal people could think possible. With even the simplest of items, Cliffheart is capable of traversing obstacles that would stop most people in their tracks. Cliffheart is more comfortable using her climbing instruments than a traditional melee weapon. Even on the battlefield, she uses these tools as weapons. Don't question the power of her snow spade or ice pick - in the hands of the right person, even instruments such as these can be lethal.

While attempting to climb the holy mountain, Cliffheart was pierced by an Originium stone during an unexpected landslide and thus became Infected. Fortunately, most of the people of Kjerag hold no prejudice against the Infected, and Cliffheart still managed to lead a normal life. Still, in order to make the Originium crystals on her body not appear so conspicuous, she takes clever steps to hide it. Thus, even outside Kjerag, she is free to move as she pleases.

As a member of the Silverash Family, she garners a lot of attention despite not appearing as elite as her older brother and sister. Unlike her siblings, she is not bound by any official position and thus is free to speak. Therefore, she often mingles with the common people, listening to their stories, learning about their lives, and studying their skills. She then uses these things she's learned to contribute to her clan.

Whatever peace the Silverash Family had came to an end when Pramanix was anointed saint. SilverAsh could no longer interacted with Cliffheart in the open, and Pramanix couldn't communicate with either of them because of her newfound official position. This made Cliffheart furious, but she understood that there was no way for the three of them to be as they once were. There was nothing she could do to fix the situation, and this feeling of helplessness made her disheartened for the first time in her life. Still, if there were anything she could do to reunite with her brother and sister, she gladly do what it takes.

Cliffheart seems to always instill feelings of cheer and optimism in those she meets, though her soul burns with the desire to inflict mischief. If you bite into a piece of cake only to find it full of beans, or your employee card has gone missing, there's a high probability that Cliffheart is responsible. If not, then she'll likely find out who is. Making mischief and exposing other mischief makers are two of her favorite pastimes.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Uh... Doctor, you really need to work out more, you know.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Everyone's really nice here at Rhodes Island. Too nice to prank. Oh, is it time for lunch? I'll help!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Mountaineering's not just a hobby of mine, it's my career! You heard me: career!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The hoop on my leg? Oh, you mean what it's for? It's just for decoration. I've got this crystal over here, see. Wanna touch?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My brother sent Matterhorn to look after me, didn't he…? Ugh, why can't he just come out and tell me what he's thinking? It drives me mad.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've always wanted to climb the holy Mt. Karlan, and I've only wanted it even more since my sister left us and became the Saintess. So Doctor, train me more, yeah? So one day I can reach the peak of Mt. Karlan and bring my sister home.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: When it comes to Mountaineering, I won't lose to anyone! No one knows these tools better than me. They make great weapons too!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Yeah, Oripathy really changed me. But if I keep wallowing in self-pity, that wouldn't be like me, right? So, no matter what lies in wait in the future... I should continue working hard on my chosen path.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Ah, it's snowing... We Silverashes can't go back to the way we were... I get that. Everything's changed. Only the snow is the same—the same snowflakes that I watched falling back home.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctoooor? Doctooooor! Heeeey! Fine, if you're just gonna sleep, then so be it. Bye-bye!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Cliffheart, and I live to conquer the peaks! It's nice to meet you!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hmm... what a novel experience!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? Wow! Let's celebrate with some cake. Look, I grabbed these from Logistics. It's fine!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Well, well, you really know what you're doing, Doctor! That's right, I'm really talented. You'd better use my power well!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: All right? I'm feeling motivated! Time to climb all the way to the top!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Eh? You want me to lead? This is all so sudden...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Say goodbye to the reckless Cliffheart. I'm taking things seriously from here on out.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'll show them what I can do!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Over here?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Leave it to me!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'm raring to go!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'veeee got yoooou!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: My hook never misses! I've got this!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Amateurs are doomed to fall to their death!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: For the Silverash name!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: There ain't no mountain too high, no situation too bleak!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Of course we won with me around!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Wow, they sure are good at running away!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Dangit... I messed up...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's so warm here... I'll hang out over here for a while!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: W-wait! Whuah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I'm gonna teach you all about Mountaineering next time, Doctor! You'll love it, I promise!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! Look, Doctor, I've prepared all this Mountaineering gear for you. Let's go! Huh? It's still midnight, you say? It's fine! We need to set off earlier so that we can catch the sunrise at the peak.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Mornin', Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Speaking of which, lemme have a look at what my brother gave you! Aww... he's still into this pricey boring ornament stuff. Zero times as practical as my present. Anyway, check this out, Doctor! A choice set of climbing equipment, just for you. Once the weather's good, let's go scale some mountains!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: My brother and sister are still butting heads, but their relationship's smoothed out a bunch, I can feel it. Gotta thank you for melting the ice between them, Doctor. But still, I really wish hanging around home was as chill as being at Rhodes Island…
